purpose: Prevent mutable status sheets from becoming independent sources of truth.
principles: append-only evidence and immutable receipts outrank copied current-state prose
source_frontier, runtime_attestation_frontier and provider_effect_proof are independent dimensions
persisted source observations are as-of checkpoints, never perpetual currentness
present-tense current claims require query-time provider readback
historical attestations are never rewritten to match later source advancement
projection writes require expected-source/revision preconditions and post-write readback
projection maturity never exceeds the weakest required proof dimension
forbidden_shortcuts: rewrite historical attestation sha to current source
treat raw OOXML v payload as displayed cell without decoding type
promote provider subcapability to system-wide maturity
use stale copied projection to contradict newer immutable receipt
claim current from a persisted SHA without fresh readback
